name: @local/dsh-ollama-autostart
description: dsh-mnemon extension for DSH: auto-starts the ollama serve background service when the host boots, with a Plugins-page control panel (auto-start switch, manual start, /api/tags listen check, direct /api/embed test, Ollama version check, forced-IPv4 CLI test). 本插件为 dsh-mnemon 扩展插件，安装 dsh-mnemon 后再使用。
